title: FlowEditOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow edit --json`: the draft the operator or the agent edits.

dir.description: Absolute path of the draft directory.

base_version.description: Number of the version the draft was made from; absent if the project had no flow and the draft was created empty.

created.description: Whether this call created the draft; false if the draft was open already and the edit continues in it.
